apps.localizedDescription:
Ryuzu is a Nintendo Switch emulator for iPhone and iPad, built on the Eden core.

• Touch controls with the Zone layout, plus hardware controller support
• Load games and keys from files or whole folders, in place
• Shader cache progress with a skip button, and save import and export
• Detailed logs you can send straight from the app

You need your own keys, firmware and games. A JIT enabler such as StikDebug is required.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Ryuzu can use Bluetooth game controllers.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Some games use the microphone. It is only used while a game that asks for it is running.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Ryuzu uses motion data for games that read the console gyroscope.
